title: Reported military clash with aliens at Dulce

tellings.quote: uh Leonard Stringfield talked to me about it and he said he'd heard three different versions.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, recalls a story about a fight between US soldiers and aliens near Dulce, a small town in northern New Mexico, in the late 1970s. He says Leonard Stringfield, a researcher who collected accounts of crashed saucers, told him about it and said he had heard three different versions.
